papers.title_en: SynerGest: Temporal-Spatial Synergistic Gesture Generation for Dyadic Conversations
papers.authors: Chengxiang Guo, Jian Wang, Lanmiao Liu, Zhan Tang, Junhua Fei, Xiao Li
papers.evidence: 使用对比流匹配进行共语手势（人体动作）生成
papers.tldr: 双人对话共语手势生成需兼顾运动学稳定与节奏响应，现有方法易陷入平均姿态回归或细微抖动，并存在语义纠缠。SynerGest 以对比流匹配目标惩罚错配语义对，抑制空间捷径与过度平滑，提升条件语义对齐；并提出脉冲-趋势协同注意力，将“动什么”与“何时动”解耦，分别建模语音驱动的节奏脉冲与连续运动趋势。在两个公开数据集上定性定量均达最优，生成上下文响应且运动流畅的双人交互手势。
papers.abstract_en: Co-speech gesture generation in dyadic conversations for creating immersive virtual avatars remains highly challenging. Existing models often struggle to balance kinematic stability with rhythmic responsiveness and suffer from semantic entanglement, leading to either generic mean-pose regression or unnatural micro-jitters. To address these challenges, we propose SynerGest, a high-fidelity dyadic gesture generation framework grounded in Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM). Specifically, our CFM objective explicitly penalizes mismatched semantic pairs during training, discouraging spatial shortcuts and over-smoothed predictions while improving conditional semantic alignment. Furthermore, to overcome architectural bottlenecks, we introduce the Impulse-Trend Synergistic Attention (ITSA) module. Grounded in the key insight of decoupling "what moves" from "when it moves," ITSA models sharp, speech-driven rhythmic impulses separately from continuous kinematic trends, supporting precise audio-motion synchronization and global structural stability. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations on two public datasets demonstrate that SynerGest achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering contextually responsive and kinematically fluid dyadic interactions.

papers.title_en: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
papers.evidence: 使用流匹配生成模型并通过信噪比调优实现图像合成
papers.tldr: 流匹配模型虽能高质量生成图像，但细粒度空间布局控制仍依赖结构适配器或推理时引导。作者用几何图元合成基准与颜色感知布局指标，发现SNR分布决定空间定位，高噪声阶段是关键学习期。将训练重心移向高噪声后，布局遵循率从25.9%升至80.8%，逼近VAE重建上限83.6%，COCO平均精度达57.3。该工作表明仅调SNR分布即可解锁空间控制，无需架构修改。
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.

papers.title_en: From Global to Tail Convergence: Dynamics of $α$-Stable Score-Based Generative Models
papers.evidence: 面向分数扩散类生成模型的理论收敛分析
papers.tldr: 针对α稳定Lévy过程驱动的分数生成模型缺乏理论保证，本文建立保尺度生成动力学的非渐近收敛分析，覆盖紧支撑与幂律目标。以p-Wasserstein距离量化早停、初始化、分数近似和时间离散化误差，并证明初始化误差指数衰减。进一步比较布朗动力学：全局收敛不足以区分二者，但尾部存在清晰分离，稳定动力学在任意正生成时刻产生指数α的幂律尾。结果表明尾部指数匹配（α=ν）是捕捉极端事件的关键机制。
papers.abstract_en: Score-based generative models driven by $α$-stable L{é}vy processes have been proposed as an alternative to Brownian diffusion models, with empirical evidence suggesting improved sampling and better modeling of heavy-tailed data. Yet theoretical guarantees for these models remain limited. We develop a non-asymptotic convergence analysis for scale-preserving $α$-stable generative dynamics, covering both compactly supported and power-law targets. In p-Wasserstein distance, we quantify the effects of early stopping, initialization, score approximation, and time discretization, and show exponential decay of the initialization error. A comparison with Brownian dynamics reveals that global Wasserstein convergence alone does not fundamentally distinguish the two models: both initialization errors decay exponentially with the forward horizon on the common class of heavy-tailed targets. A sharp separation emerges instead in the tails. At any positive generation time, stable dynamics produces power-law tails with index $α$, whereas Brownian dynamics remains light-tailed. For a target with tail index $ν$, asymptotically correct extreme-quantile scaling is possible precisely when $α$=$ν$. These results identify tail-index matching as a principled mechanism behind the ability of stable generative models to capture extreme events.

papers.title_en: Steered Not Stirred: Effective Reward Tilting using Surrogate Reward Mixing
papers.authors: Alec Sargood, Olivia Gallup, Georg Maierhofer, Noam Ghenassia, Paul Duckworth, Krisztina Sinkovics, Avishek Joey Bose
papers.evidence: 通过代理奖励混合引导扩散与流匹配生成模型
papers.tldr: 连续时间生成模型（扩散、流匹配、流映射）依赖高保真与可引导性，但真实oracle奖励常不可得或昂贵。MARTINI利用少量oracle排序或数值反馈，学习多个廉价代理奖励的组合，从而在推理时把预训练模型导向由不可见R*定义的倾斜分布。理论刻画代理信息上限，并在小倾斜强度下联系总体恢复误差与理想目标KL；实验在语言生成、ImageNet对齐和蛋白-配体共折叠上提升oracle倾斜保真度与位姿准确性/有效性，且推理时无需查询oracle。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time generative models, from diffusion models, flow matching, and now flow maps, owe their practical value to high-fidelity generation and steerability. In many applications, a ground-truth latent ``oracle'' reward $R^*$ is unavailable or expensive to evaluate, e.g., human judgments or experimental measurements. Although the oracle reward is not directly observable, it can often be approximated through multiple cheaper surrogates that, individually, provide incomplete characterizations but collectively reveal substantial information about the downstream task. In this paper, we present a method for composing such surrogates to steer a pretrained model toward the distribution tilted by an unavailable $R^*$. Given a small feedback set of oracle rankings or numerical rewards, we introduce Mixing And Reward Tilting for INference-time Improvement (MARTINI), which learns a surrogate composition for plug-and-play use with standard inference-time steering methods. Our theory characterizes surrogate information limits and relates population recovery error to ideal-target KL at small tilt strength. For preferences, the bound additionally accounts for an irreducible mismatch between the Plackett-Luce population target and the conditional mean. Experiments demonstrate improved oracle-tilt fidelity in language generation and ImageNet alignment, and improved joint pose accuracy and validity in protein-ligand cofolding, without inference-time oracle queries.

papers.title_en: From Short Clips to Real-Time Streams: Identity-Aware Supervision and Context-Efficient Generation for Video Face Swapping
papers.authors: Zekai Luo, Yuwei Liang, Ruiqi Ma, Haoyu Huang, Xuehao Wang, Huanyi Zheng, Mingyu Liu, Linhao Zhong, Chenchen Jing, Yuling Xi, Hao Chen
papers.evidence: 基于参考引导流匹配的视频换脸与身份感知监督
papers.tldr: 视频人脸换脸需要在长视频流中同时做到身份迁移准确、画面保真和实时生成，现有参考引导的流匹配方法难以兼顾。本文提出StreamingSwap，用Joint Rec-ID Loss按噪声水平平衡身份监督与潜在重建，并借助Face-RoI Generation与短上下文Rollout训练减少空间token和时间上下文。方法在单张RTX 4090上达到20 FPS，可稳定生成最长10分钟视频，并构建了含1000小时数据的HumanFaceVid基准。
papers.abstract_en: Video face swapping transfers the reference identity to a target video while preserving its other attributes and motion. Despite recent progress in reference-guided flow-based methods, jointly achieving faithful identity transfer, high fidelity, and real-time generation over long video streams remains challenging. To address this challenge, we rethink the task-specific structure of reference-guided video face swapping. First, face swapping changes only identity while preserving most visual content, yet flow-matching supervision is weakly sensitive to these changes. We therefore develop Joint Rec-ID Loss, which balances explicit identity supervision and latent reconstruction according to the noise level. Second, the target video already provides non-edited attributes and temporal dynamics, enabling generation with fewer spatial tokens and shorter temporal contexts through Face-RoI Generation and Short-Context Rollout Training. By integrating these designs, we propose StreamingSwap, a reference-guided flow-matching framework for real-time streaming video face swapping. We also introduce HumanFaceVid, comprising 1,000 hours of cinematic training data and evaluation sets of 200 short and 200 long videos. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive identity transfer and visual quality at 20 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, with stable generation over videos up to 10 minutes long. Project webpage: https://aim-uofa.github.io/StreamingSwap/

papers.title_en: Learn to Modify: Self-evolving Multi-agent Refinement Framework for Conversational Text-to-Motion Generation
papers.authors: Jianan Li, Jiawei Zhao, Yangtao Zhou, Zhifu Zhao, Shaoxin Wu, Yutao Wang, Dezhen Wang, Hua Chu, Fu Li
papers.evidence: 支持局部精炼的对话式文本到动作生成
papers.tldr: 现有文本到动作生成多为单次生成，用户不满细节时需整段重生成，效率低且破坏已建立的运动上下文。论文提出会话式动作生成范式，并设计自演化多智能体细化框架SMART，协调指令理解、生成、局部编辑与质量评估。其中语义引导掩码编辑将反馈定位到时空区域，记忆式自演化策略复用历史编辑经验。实验表明SMART支持多轮会话生成并高效细化动作。
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in text-to-motion generation, existing methods are commonly designed for single-shot generation. When users are dissatisfied with specific motion details, they are often forced to regenerate the entire sequence from scratch, which is computationally inefficient and potentially destroys previously established kinematic context. A practical generation system should instead support iterative user feedback and refine only the affected spatio-temporal regions while preserving the remaining motion. Therefore, we introduce a conversational motion generation paradigm that requires the system to coordinate instruction understanding, motion generation, localized editing, and quality assessment. Recent advances in LLM-driven multi-agent systems provide a promising foundation for such role-specialized coordination. To tackle these challenges, a Self-evolving Multi-Agent RefinemenT Framework (SMART) is proposed for conversational motion generation. Within SMART, to preserve semantic consistency, we design a semantic-guided masked motion editing mechanism, which precisely grounds natural language feedback into spatiotemporal motion regions to enable localized refinements without altering unedited regions. To reduce redundant exploration, we propose a memory-based self-evolving strategy that dynamically accumulates motion editing knowledge from interaction history and reuses past successful experience. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SMART effectively supports multi-turn conversational motion generation and enables efficient motion refinement.

papers.title_en: Integrating Flow Matching and Model Predictive Control for Safe Robot Navigation
papers.authors: Philipp Holzmann, Maik Pfefferkorn, Joao Carvalho, Ali Younes, An Thai Le, Georgia Chalvatzaki, Jan Peters, Rolf Findeisen
papers.evidence: 流匹配轨迹生成结合模型预测控制实现安全机器人导航
papers.tldr: 针对扩散与流匹配路径规划器虽能生成多样轨迹、却难以在部署时满足约束和避障的问题，本文提出将流匹配路径规划与模型预测路径跟随控制结合的框架。流匹配模型学习多模态路径分布，预测控制器利用实时局部感知在线调整运动，满足状态与输入约束并降低碰撞风险。事件触发重规划把控制解反馈给后续路径生成，提升未知障碍环境下的无碰撞导航能力，移动机器人仿真验证了其在杂乱场景中的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based path planners based on diffusion and flow matching can generate diverse trajectories from demonstrations but typically lack mechanisms for constraint satisfaction and collision avoidance during deployment. This work proposes a framework that combines flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive path-following control to integrate data-driven path generation with real-time, constraint-aware execution. The flow-matching model captures multimodal path distributions, while the predictive controller adapts motion online to satisfy state and input constraints and avoid obstacles using updated local sensor information. An event-triggered re-planning scheme incorporates predictive control solutions into subsequent path generation, promoting collision-free navigation in environments with previously unseen obstacles. Simulation results for mobile robot navigation demonstrate robust performance across cluttered environments. The framework provides a systematic approach to combining flow matching with predictive control for adaptive, data-driven navigation.

papers.title_en: Velocity Ambiguity Profiles: Time-Resolved Bayes-Risk Diagnostics for Flow Matching
papers.authors: Yunpeng Mei, Xiaowen Zhu, Chenyu Wang, Chenbo Xin, Hongjie Cao, Jiamin Wang, Jie Chen, Gang Wang
papers.evidence: 流匹配的时间分辨贝叶斯风险诊断
papers.tldr: 流匹配训练连续速度回归问题，但通常只报告对插值时间平均的损失，难以区分内在歧义与数据不足造成的误差。作者提出速度歧义剖面 VAP，将时间局部损失分解为贝叶斯风险下界与可约误差，并给出非参数与高斯混合下的统计基准。高斯混合实验验证了该诊断，在 CIFAR-100 DINOv2 特征流上引导时间采样使速度损失降 6.78%、全局 FD 降 23.6%。VAP 把平均目标变成定位歧义受限与数据受限区域的时间分辨诊断工具。
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching trains a continuum of velocity regression problems but usually reports a loss averaged over interpolation time, obscuring which regions are limited by intrinsic ambiguity and which remain data-limited. We introduce the Velocity Ambiguity Profile (VAP), $\mathcal{A}_v(t)$, the time-local Bayes-risk floor of velocity prediction, and decompose time-resolved loss as $L_N(t)=\mathcal{A}_v(t)+R(t;N)$, where only the excess term $R(t;N)$ is reducible by more data or a different estimator. For $N$ training samples and a $K$-component mixture in the structured example, we prove two statistical benchmarks. In an intrinsic local-regression benchmark, $\mathcal{A}_v(t)$ enters the time-dependent noise factor of the standard nonparametric rate. In separated isotropic Gaussian mixtures, the Bayes velocity becomes locally affine, and a label-oracle residual-regression benchmark has parametric excess-risk scale $K\mathcal{A}_v(t)/N$, matched within the same separated residual Gaussian-location subproblem. Controlled Gaussian-mixture experiments validate this diagnostic through a dense transition sweep, calibrated oracle-to-blind and empirical-proxy audits, and a local controlled time-sampler stress test in which a frozen reducible-error proxy reduces reducible loss while cross-cell sensitivity delimits aggressive sampling. On CIFAR-100 DINOv2 feature flow, guided time sampling reduces uniformly evaluated velocity loss by $6.78\%$ and global feature Fréchet distance (FD) by $23.6\%$, while class-conditional kernel inception distance (KID) shows no improvement. VAP turns an averaged flow-matching objective into a time-resolved diagnostic for locating ambiguity-limited and data-limited regions.
